tokenString.description: Token string identifying the bank card verification session.

expiration.description: Date and time when this token will become expired.

isValid.description: Indicates whether this token is valid.

sessionUrl.description: The URL to send your end user to in order to complete the card check.

mobileCode.description: Eight-digit code the end user can enter in the iDenfy mobile app to open this session. Returned only when `generateMobileCode` was set.
